_about: TEMPLATE 'birch' + WORKED EXAMPLE — a 59s launch film for 'Birch', a fictional brand engine: point it at a domain, it reads the site, extracts the brand, and generates any on-brand asset from a prompt.

The copy is placeholder. To retarget it to a real product, rewrite the role-tagged scenes per templates/README.md and keep every timing exactly as-is — startMs, durationMs, easings, camera keys and ground stops ARE the template.

Three fictional customer brands live inside the demo scenario and are meant to be replaced along with the copy: Lantern (a maker marketplace — the site the film reads at 4.8-25.7s), Ashvale (a coffee roaster) and Quarry (a hardware residency), each appearing as a prompt-card brand and as the poster that prompt generates.

ONE image asset: ../../../templates/birch/aperture-mark.png — the path is resolved by the browser relative to src/lib/textcards/index.html. It is the product's mark on the end card, the mark on every generated poster, and the shape of both drift layers. Swapping that one file re-brands the whole film.

No screen in this film is a dashed placeholder: the site the product reads is the 'site-page' preset and the brand kit it builds is 'brand-sheet', both drawn inside their media-window so they ride its glide, hold and punch.
Every text scene carries a 'role' so a model can tell brand copy from in-product dialogue — see the Copy roles table in src/lib/textcards/README.md.

_acts: 0.0-4.8s   opener — three serif claims on white, each cooling through a pink→ink gradient front, ending in a burst of brand marks.
4.8-7.8s   the ask — the domain field, typed, then punched into on a black submit.
7.8-13.7s  the read — an orb loader with rolling status labels, brand marks tumbling past.
13.7-25.7s the evidence — the customer's site scrolling inside a card, then the brand-kit sheet, then the success card. Painterly grounds behind the card edges.
25.7-33.3s the turn — 'and like magic' → 'your brand is extracted' → 'Generate any brand asset'.
33.3-53.5s the loop, three times — prompt card (type a request, pick a brand, submit) → the generated poster revealed by a pixel-sort dissolve.
53.5-59.0s the closer — 'Try today' → the URL → marks drifting up → the lockup, dead still to the last frame.
